title: Propped cantilever under its own weight

source.work: Bentley Systems, STAAD.Pro Help, Verification Examples (public documentation, docs.bentley.com)
source.edition: STAAD.Pro Help v21 build (pages refer to the STAAD.Pro 2023 sample files), read 2026-11-22
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text and input listing). The page cites: Roark and Young, Formulas for Stress and Strain, 5th ed., p. 109, no. 23 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'theory' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane problem in the global X-Y plane (Y vertical); the out-of-plane DOFs (uz, rx, ry) of every node are held; in-plane bending about local z. Beam of 100 in, simply supported at node 1 (x = 0), built in at x = 100 in; A = 4 in^2, Iz = 1.3333 in^4, depth 2 in, E = 30e6 psi; load = self weight with the density of the page's input listing, 0.282072 lb/in^3 (the page's text rounds it to 0.2821; the printed results correspond to the listing). A node at x = 42.15 in. First-order analysis, no shear deformation. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
